messages:
deploy-bot: Hotfix requested for `inference-gateway-eu1` -> prod-eu1. Symptom: intermittent 504s on long-stream requests after yesterday's routing tweak. Owner: karim. Patch: revert stream keepalive change + add backpressure guard. Runbook: https://go/internal/runbooks/inference-gateway-keepalive-hotfix

karim: short summary: noticed 504 regression correlated with longer client streams. Staging repro with 10s+ streams. Patch validated in staging under load. Need fast approval window 1m prep.
messages_addendum:
eva: Ack. Paste rollback steps and exact abort criteria?

ops-lead: Rollback tested in staging:
```
kubectl -n redwood set image deploy/inference-gateway gateway=registry.redwood/gateway:release-2026-03-10
kubectl rollout status deploy/inference-gateway
```
Abort if 5xx > 1% for 5m OR p95 stream latency + error increase. Need 2 approvals + ops-lead.

sam: +1 1 I'll be on-call for 30m post-deploy. Watching 504 and pod restarts.

rachel: +1 and will keep an eye on egress LB stats. Please include release-note link before full rollout.

deploy-bot: Approval flow: react with :thumbsup: to approve. Auto-start in 4m if 2 approvals.

sam: :thumbsup:

rachel: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Approval threshold reached. Starting canary: 5% traffic to canary pool. Image: registry.redwood/gateway:hotfix-keepalive-2026-03-23

deploy-bot: Canary details:
Targets: pool-eu1-canary
Traffic ramp: 5% -> 50% over 12m if stable
Health checks: streaming health probe + /health

karim: Drafting release note: https://docs.redwood/internal/release-notes/gateway-hotfix-2026-03-23 1 includes RCA, mitigation and rollback snippet.

sam: Metrics: canary 504s fell from 2.5% -> 0.2% in 6m. No pod OOMs. Good.

rachel: LB egress stable. Recommend ramp to 50% now and hold 15m.

deploy-bot: Canary moved to 50%. Full rollout scheduled after 15m stable window.

ops-lead: If any 5xx spike >1% occurs abort and run rollback command above. Otherwise proceed after window.

karim: Thanks all 1 will update release note with exact timeline and close thread after post-rollout verification.

sam: Post-rollout check 25m: overall 504s at 0.15%, p95 latency unchanged. Ending watch in 5m. :tada:
